name: YesterSol
storyline:
Embark on an epic journey as Corin, a young Soladin—a sun warrior in training. Armed with a magical SolSpear that doubles as a throw-able weapon and platform to stand on, you venture into a cursed land destroyed by Culex, an ancient evil once imprisoned in the moon.

Uncover the origin of monstrous mosquito minions that ravaged your town, determined to prevent such devastation again. Journey into an ancient underground city sustained by a HeatSeed, generating endless steam. This city was once part of the SolLuna Kingdom, torn apart by a civil war born from differing beliefs.

Navigate through the remnants of this kingdom, battle foes, and explore the ancient city to unearth a solution and numerous secrets. The fate of your people rests on your shoulders as you confront the shadows of a fractured past.
summary: Unleash your magical spear! Explore a vast inter-connected world, battling enemies sent by Culex, the dark mosquito deity. Throw, recall, and use your spear as a platform through this minimalistic metroidvania made by one developer!
